annotations.text:
Individual project template — Research / Development / Delivery.
Generic: every [BRACKET] is a slot, and the bracket text says what belongs there and roughly how long it should be, so the proportions here are honest rather than lorem.
A sticky rail on the left tracks the three chapters; on mobile it becomes a sticky strip under the masthead.

The desktop page is ONE arrangement of these blocks. Different projects need different arrangements — compose each chapter from whichever earn their place and delete the rest rather than filling them.
Note the two rules at the bottom of this sheet: body text stops at 680px however wide the page gets, and every image earns a caption that says something the photograph doesn't.
